capability.summary: Run Pyflakes on one local Python path and return diagnostic lines
capability.description: Executes `[sys.executable, -m, pyflakes, target]`, concatenates stdout then stderr, splits non-empty lines into issues, and reports their count and Pyflakes exit code without executing or modifying analyzed source.
capability.problem_space: Narrow Pyflakes diagnostics for Python syntax/name/unused-import style issues; not comprehensive static analysis, formatting, type checking, security scanning, dead-code proof, runtime testing, or code repair.

env_requirements: pyflakes importable by the current Python interpreter
constraint.io_signature: Input: required file_path string naming an existing Python file or path accepted by Pyflakes. Executes current Python `-m pyflakes <target>`. Output: JSON envelope with exit_code, issue_count, and combined stdout/stderr diagnostic lines.
accepted_inputs: an existing Python source file intended for Pyflakes analysis
an existing path that the installed Pyflakes version accepts as a target
constraint.output_shape: After Pyflakes returns: {status: "success", tool: "pyflakes", target: string, exit_code: integer, issue_count: integer, issues: [string]}, wrapper exit 0 regardless of Pyflakes exit. Missing target: {status: "error", message: string}, exit 2. Missing argument prints usage to stderr and exits 1 without JSON. A 120-second timeout or subprocess launch failure is uncaught and may traceback.
limitations: Pyflakes provides a focused diagnostic set and does not enforce formatting/style rules broadly, infer types, identify security vulnerabilities, or perform Vulture-style dead-code analysis
combines stdout and stderr into one unstructured list and counts lines rather than parsed diagnostics; tool/module failures can appear as issues
does not execute or modify analyzed code, apply fixes, accept custom flags, or truncate output
uses a fixed 120-second timeout that is not converted into a JSON error envelope

output_contract.description: JSON envelope containing Pyflakes exit code and combined diagnostic lines with a line count; analyzed code is unchanged.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: run Pyflakes on a Python source path
find undefined names and unused imports with Pyflakes
negative_intents: perform comprehensive Python static analysis or type checking
scan Python code for security vulnerabilities or dead code
format fix or execute Python source
